description: Plan your gig: ordered setlist with song durations, total stage time, encore split and automatic saving.

faqs.a: Yes — your setlist is saved in this browser's localStorage automatically and restored when you return.
Tick the encore box on any song — encore songs get their own subtotal below the main set.
faqs.q: How does the encore split work?

faqs.a: Type minutes:seconds (3:45) or decimal minutes (3.75) — both are understood.

howto: Type a song name and duration, then click "Add song".
Reorder with the ↑ ↓ buttons; tick "encore" for encore songs.
Watch the main-set, encore and total times update live.
Copy the setlist to share it with your band.
title: Setlist Planner
